intro.title: Zustand Persist Middleware
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple counter application that saves its state even after refreshing the page. You will learn how to use Zustand's persist middleware to automatically store your application's state in the browser's localStorage. The core concept involves configuring a Zustand store with middleware to handle state persistence seamlessly. You will work with React components, TypeScript for type safety, and the Zustand library to manage and persist state. By the end, you'll understand how to make your app's state survive browser reloads with just a few lines of code.
intro.usecase: Zustand Persist Middleware is essential for maintaining user preferences and application state across sessions in real-world applications. In dashboard interfaces like analytics tools or project management platforms, it preserves user-customized layouts, column visibility, and filter settings when users return. E-commerce sites use it to persist shopping cart items and recently viewed products, while form-heavy applications like survey builders or configuration wizards save draft progress automatically. This pattern ensures critical UI state—such as collapsed panels, theme selections, or data table sorting—survives page refreshes and browser restarts, creating a seamless user experience.
